probe_build.profile: opt-level 3, lto fat, codegen-units 1, panic abort (the workspace release profile)
probe_build.lock_origin: the workspace Cargo.lock copied, then pruned by cargo build (no hand edit); the workspace Cargo.lock is unchanged

why_a_probe: The diagnostic test measure_fixed_width_against_indexed_whole_solves alternates both kernels inside one process, so perf stat over it counts both arms together and gives no ratio. The probe runs one kernel per process. The test itself is still run three times under perf stat (diagnostic_runs) for its identity assertions; its counts and wall medians are reported only.
per_solve: for each round, cell and arm: (C(1 + N) - C(1)) / N for instructions:u and cycles:u, where C(s) is the count of the process with s solves
order: cells n1e4 then n1e5; rounds 1 and 3: indexed then fixed2; round 2: fixed2 then indexed; within an arm: solves 1 then 1 + N
quiet_rule: before each process: wait until the 1-minute load average is <= 3.0 (checked every 5 s, at most 600 s) and record it; the agent starts no other process or tool call during the series
statistic: per cell and metric: ratio = median over rounds of per-solve fixed2 / median over rounds of per-solve indexed; the per-round ratios fixed2/indexed are reported
identity: within each cell every probe line (both arms, both solve counts, all rounds) has equal attempts, accepted, rejected, jacobian_reuses, lu, work, partial, success, message, counters, internal_steps, output_clipped_steps, outputs and state_fnv1a; the driver id differs by design
the non-ignored tests of banded_kernel_entry_identity pass (cargo test --locked -p rodas5p-integrators --release --test banded_kernel_entry_identity)
each of the three diagnostic runs passes (its assert_same_banded on the FixedWidth2 and Indexed results at both sizes)
diagnostic_runs: three runs, after the series, of the test binary of banded_kernel_entry_identity (built by the command of PLAN.json KS-N1 before the series): perf stat -x, -e instructions:u,cycles:u,task-clock -o <csv> -- taskset -c 3 <test binary> measure_fixed_width_against_indexed_whole_solves --exact --ignored --nocapture; reported only

verdict.PASS: identity holds, cycles decidable, and at both cells instructions ratio <= 0.60 and cycles ratio <= 0.80
verdict.KILL: identity holds, cycles decidable, and cycles ratio > 0.95 at both cells
verdict.FAIL: identity holds and neither PASS nor KILL; with undecidable cycles: an instructions ratio > 0.60 at any cell
verdict.NOT_DECIDABLE: cycles undecidable and every instructions ratio <= 0.60
verdict.cycles_undecidable_if: a process of the series started with a 1-minute load average > 3.0 after the wait, or in some cell the per-round cycles ratios spread by more than 0.10 (max / min - 1)
verdict.fallback_on_any_verdict_but_PASS: PLAN.json: keep the promotion (bits are identical) and record the negative performance cell

pilot_before_this_protocol: plumbing only: smoke runs of both arms at rows = 100 (n = 200: 18 attempts, equal work and counters in both arms) and one indexed solve per deciding size to choose N (process wall 0.035 s at n = 1e4 and 0.298 s at n = 1e5); no fixed2 run at a deciding size
